t: Choosing the Perfect Loom—For You | Handwoven
s: July 15, 2024 - If a new loom is out of your budget, consider previously loved looms. Often used looms come with bonus yarns, tools, reeds, and maybe even a bench! One warning: Beware of buying a used loom without inspecting it in person. It’s just too easy to overlook missing parts (brake cranks are important) or broken parts (such as cracked beater supports) when you buy based only on photos.
